messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PAGER fired — PG-CONN-EXHAUST-prod-primary. Severity: P2. Trigger: postgres.connections > 950 (limit 1000).

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert sent to oncall (Sam H).

Sam H: Acked. I'm looking. seeing rapid climb in active connections on primary-db-redwood-prod.

Ria: Observability shows write latency spike and a lot of short lived connections from job-worker and embed-service. p95 write 2.4s -> 9.8s.

Joon: Any obvious deploys in last 10m?

Sam H: No recent deploys. Checking queries:

Sam H: ```
SELECT datname, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY datname;
-- lots of connections from job_worker (user: rw_jobs) and embed_service (user: embeddings)
```

Maria P: I'm seeing many failed client connections (ECONNRESET) reported by embed-service traces. Might be bursty fan-out when batch embed task retries.

SRE Bot: Current connections: 983. max_connections=1000. Active backends: 950+ for >60s. Replication lag nominal.

Ria: Customer impact? Any 5xx from APIs?

Sam H: Yes — some write-heavy endpoints returning 503s, embed latency spiking; estimated 4-7% error rate across requests to /v1/embeddings. No total outage but degraded SLAs.

Joon: Short-term mitigation: can we throttle job-worker and batch embed pipeline? We can flip the feature-flag to disable non-critical background batches.

Maria P: I can patch the feature-flag in LaunchDarkly. Will flip to reduce concurrency.

Sam H: Also toggling connection pool to prefer persistent pooled connections. For services using direct DB connections, set PG_MAX_CONNS lower so they use pooled connections. Sending comms to infra config.

Ria: Alternative: bring up pgbouncer pooler in transaction pooling mode on primary to reduce backend count. How long to spin up?

Joon: We have pgbouncer available but need config + deploy. Can spin a canary in us-west-2 in ~6-8m. Might be faster to scale down job-worker and restart embedding workers sequentially.

Sam H: Action list:
- Maria: flip LD flag to stop batch embedding jobs (reduces new DB work) — IN PROGRESS.
- Joon: scale job-worker replicas to 1 (from 6) — doing now.
- Ria: prepare pgbouncer deploy if throttle doesn't reduce connections within 10m.
- Sam H: monitor connections, error rate, and alert if >98% of max.

Maria P: Flipped flag. Background batches stopping. I also paused the retry loop for embed-service for new jobs.

SRE Bot: job-worker scaled from 6 -> 1 (k8s). Pods terminating. Expected to reduce connection churn.

Sam H: Connection count dropping: 983 -> 780 -> 520 over 3m. Errors also falling: 5.4% -> 1.2%. Good.

Ria: Nice. Keep monitoring. If connections stabilize under 650 and errors under 1%, we can keep current config and do a planned follow-up to add connection pooling.

Joon: I'll keep pgbouncer cookbooks ready. If we need it later, can do a quick rollout.

Maria P: Customer impact note: I've notified CS and added the incident to the triage queue. No major enterprise customers reported data loss; only increased latency/errors.

Sam H: Marking as acknowledged and mitigated. We'll keep the thread open for a post-incident review. Handoff: I'm staying on for 15m then handing to next oncall. If things regress, page me.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert resolved (PG-CONN-EXHAUST-prod-primary) — condition cleared below threshold.

Sam H: Closing thread once metrics stable for 30m. Thanks all for quick actions. :thumbsup:
